stage_info.name: particle_picking
stage_info.description: Particle picking stage: Detect and extract particles from micrographs using blob picker

input.micrograph_location_description: Location of the micrographs for particle picking. If null, will read from the output of the preprocessing agent. Can be a CryoSPARC job UID (e.g., 'J84') or a path to micrographs.

blob_picker.particle_diameter_description: Minimum expected particle diameter in Angstroms. This is the most critical parameter for blob detection and should match the actual size of your protein complex. Typical range: 50-500 Å.
blob_picker.diameter_max_description: Maximum particle diameter in Angstroms. If null, defaults to 2.0 × particle_diameter. Defines the upper bound of the particle size search range. Useful for particles with size variation.

steps.name: blob_picker
steps.description: Detect particles using GPU-accelerated Gaussian blob detection algorithm. The blob picker identifies circular features (blobs) in micrographs within a specified diameter range.
steps.notes: Requires completed micrograph selection or CTF estimation job as input. Uses 'blob_picker_gpu' job type in CryoSPARC. The micrographs_job_uid should point to a curate_exposures_v2 job with 'exposures_accepted' output containing curated micrographs.
